row.proto: void Phys_Integrate_BodyTransform(void *body, float dt, void *axisOwner, uint8_t updateShapes)
row.notes: Saves the previous transform (+0x150..+0x1cf to +0x270..+0x2ef), advances position *(body+0x378) by dt * linear velocity +0x220, and rotates the basis rows +0x150/+0x160/+0x170 by the axis-angle of angular velocity +0x210 * dt (polynomial sin/cos, skipped when speed <= 1e-17). When axisOwner == body it re-orthonormalises the axis vectors behind +0x380/+0x388/+0x390. Rebuilds the world transform +0x190..+0x1cf (translation minus rotated COM offset +0x230), optionally updates attached shapes (list +0x360, next +0x118, world xform shape+0x50 from local +0x10 when flag +0x171 bit0), and recomputes world inertia tensors +0x90 and +0xd0 from local +0x50 and +0x110. Prime hook for reading or overriding body pose per step.
